text_block_list.name: Townsperson A
text_block_list.text:
Oh, the new Monthly Twinkle is out. As 
expected, the 'Oka Sho' special feature is 
huge.

text_block_list.name: Townsperson B
text_block_list.text:
However, the girl from the Satsuki Sho was 
amazing too! Umm, if I remember right—

text_block_list.name: Gal Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Jordan! The nails you posted yesterday 
were so cute! That was a total slay!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Riiight~? You totally get it~.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Ready, and!

text_block_list.name: Gal Umamusumes
text_block_list.text: ~~♪ Crush plus crush equals—?

text_block_list.name: Jordan and the Others
text_block_list.text: I wanna connect☆

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, looking good, right? Gonna post this 
on UmaTok!

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Tosen Jordan! You forgot you were 
called in for math, didn't you?!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Whoa. Ah...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Time to make a break for it~☆

text_block_list.name: Gal Umamusumes
text_block_list.text: Yay☆

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Ah...! Geez! I'm telling Trainer about 
this too, okay?!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Huh!? Isn't that way too unfair~?!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Ah. If it isn't Jordan-san. 'Sup.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Huh? What's that about? I hate it when 
City adds "-san" to my name.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Fufu, sorry, sorry. But you see...

text_block_list.name: Gal Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Gyaaah~!? Jordan-san is hanging out with 
City-san~!? Insane! That combo is way too 
strong!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...Fufufu, you're quite popular with them, 
aren't you? Good luck~.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Jeez, whaaaat is it?

text_block_list.name: Gal Umamusumes
text_block_list.text: Do your best! Joooordaaan!!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...Hehe. Okaaay.

On this day, I attended a lecture for 
Trainers given by special guest 
instructors on the outdoor stage.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: Huh, Trainer <username>?

She is a Trainer who joined Tracen Academy 
around the same time as me. We are 
comrades who inspire each other to strive 
for greater heights.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Are you also taking the seminar on 'New 
Proposals for Training Horseshoes', 
Trainer <username>?

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
! Could it be that you plan to take the 
"Recommended Plyometrics" and "Race 
Patterns & Racer Mindset" programs as 
well?

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
"Thank goodness...! Me too. Would it be 
alright if I joined you?"

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
"If there's anything you couldn't get down 
in your notes, I thought we could help 
each other out."
choice_data_list: By all means, I'd love to!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: Th-Thank you very much!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
"...Overtaking Front Runners based on 
preliminary movements. Pairs predicting 
inside and outside courses from the 
movements of the runner ahead... Hmm."

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Meek excels at pace-pushing and 
late-charging, so this practice should be 
quite effective!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Um, Trainer <username>! If you'd like, would you 
want to try testing out that training 
method together with us?

It was an offer too good to pass up. Tosen 
Jordan is also skilled as a Pace Setter 
and Late Charger. There's certainly no 
harm in learning it.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much! Well then, I'll be in 
your care!

And so, we arranged a joint training 
session with Trainer Kiryuin's Umamusume, 
Happy Meek.

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text: ...Hello.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Meek. This time, I want the two of you to 
run a race focused on overtaking from the 
third corner.

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text: ...Mmh.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
However, the one designated to overtake 
must stay behind until the 4th corner. And 
watch the runner ahead for any 
'preparatory movements'!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Will the runner ahead shift inside or 
outside? Watch the loading and unloading 
of weight... read those pre-movement cues, 
and pick the most efficient line to 
overtake—

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Huh? That's on a whole other level. Too 
hard. I can't even.
choice_data_list:
Shall I break the explanation down a bit 
more?

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: ! Y-Yes, of course. Pardon me. Um...

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text:
...It's okay, Trainer. You don't have to 
dumb it down for me.

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text:
I want to understand what Trainer was 
saying... I'll study the difficult words 
too.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: ...Meek.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"...Did you actually get what they were 
saying earlier? 'Cause honestly, I'm super 
stressed out over here."

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text: ……That was difficult.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: I knew it, she did the 'Ta-da~' thing...

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text:
"Still, my Trainer always gives their 
absolute all for my sake."

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text:
...I want to live up to expectations, too. 
Even if it's hard, I'll give it my all.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
...Still. Even if you wanna understand, 
there're times when you just don't get it, 
right?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...What do you do at times like that?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
What? We're doing practical training now? 
Aren't we?
choice_data_list: Do you know how you should run?
Do you know how you should run?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Ah... well... um. Ahhh...
choice_data_list:
If her ears twitch at the fourth corner, 
she's going all-out from the inside

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Huh? The opponent's?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Are you sure something so simple is okay? 
Weren't you talking about some kinda 
heavy... whatever thing earlier?
choice_data_list: It's okay, you don't need to overthink it

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...Hmm.

And so, the mock race began. This time, 
Tosen Jordan was the one doing the 
overtaking.

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text:
If a Front Runner does the preparatory 
motion of a Front Runner... they could 
confuse the opponent and... wait, huh?

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text:
? The footsteps aren't getting any closer. 
Are they... not planning to pass me? Then 
I'll just keep going like this...

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text:
...Maybe I can hold the lead all the way 
to the end.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
(Her ears turned this way at the 4th 
corner...! ...Which means...!)

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text:
! ...They're starting their spurt! I can't 
let them pass me... Huh? Whoa...!

Happy Meek pins her ears back around the 
fourth corner and launches her sprint. But 
caught by centrifugal force, she drifts 
wide to the outside.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Taaaaaahhhhh!

"Attacking from the inside, there are no 
walls ahead of Tosen Jordan! She crosses 
the finish line in a flash...!"

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: Trainer <username>, that just now was...

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
...Indeed, if an opponent begins their 
spurt during a corner, the inside tends to 
open up. Centrifugal force will inevitably 
push them wide, no matter what.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
And quite a few Umamusume unconsciously 
pin their ears back when attempting to 
unleash their final spurt. ...Bitter 
Glasse had that tendency as well.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
—Come to think of it, that's the absolute 
basics of basics. Caught up in the term 
"preparatory movement" that I learned 
today, that thought had completely slipped 
my mind.

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer. I... I got passed... Even after 
everything you taught me..."

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: ...Meek.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
...You did nothing wrong. I should be the 
one apologizing. It's just—

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Today was a day full of learning. So, 
shall we have a reflection meeting? There 
is so much... I wish to teach you.

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text:
! Yes... I will. I want to understand what 
you were saying even better, Trainer...!

And so, the joint training for the day was 
wrapped up.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer. You're pretty smart, you know.
choice_data_list:
Still, overtaking them in the end was 
entirely your own power.

Still, overtaking them in the end was 
entirely your own power.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, doing that is no good. Just accept 
it gracefully, okay~?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"...Because you're smart, right? No 
kidding."

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
...If I could properly understand your 
strategies, I wonder if I could get even 
stronger.
